name: Peg Line
summary: A wishlist on a washing line: tap a piece and it unpegs, drops into a wicker basket and adds to the total
about: Four wishlist pieces (a lawn kurta, a chiffon dupatta, wool socks and a cap) hang from wooden pegs on a rope that sags with their weight and sways in a breeze. Tapping one tugs it, opens its peg and drops it on a curve into a wicker basket that squashes and puffs hearts, while the rope springs up and the others bounce. The basket keeps a real PKR total, each piece can be hung back, and checkout restocks the line.
how: Tap a piece on the line: it gets a tug and its peg opens
The piece falls on a spinning curve into the basket, which squashes and puffs hearts
The rope springs up because it carries less weight, and the other pieces swing
The basket count, the chips and the PKR total update; the arrow on a chip hangs that piece back
Checkout fills the button, the basket hops with confetti and every piece flies back to its peg
